name: io.github.sepehr071/darukade-mcp
title: Darukade Pharmacy
description: Read-only Darukade (darukade.com) pharmacy: products, prices, ingredients, usage, reviews.

environmentVariables.name: DARUKADE_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the Darukade requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
